source.access: Public NASA/JPL API response; retain the provider and retrieval identity when redistributing.

selection.order: absolute magnitude H ascending within each orbit class
selection.interpretation: A bounded visual context sample of JPL near-Earth-object records, not the complete catalog.

value.interpretation: Published osculating elements and catalog fields are retained as reported; null values remain missing.

fields.epochTdbJd: Osculating-element epoch in TDB Julian date as returned by JPL.
fields.semiMajorAxisAu: Osculating semi-major axis in astronomical units.
fields.perihelionDistanceAu: Osculating perihelion distance in astronomical units.
fields.longitudeAscendingNodeDeg: Osculating longitude of ascending node in degrees.
fields.argumentPerihelionDeg: Osculating argument of perihelion in degrees.
fields.meanAnomalyDeg: Osculating mean anomaly at epoch in degrees.
fields.minimumOrbitIntersectionDistanceAu: Earth MOID in astronomical units, when published.
